abilities: Hosted agenda counter: The Runner moves to the outermost position of Archives
proprionegation.note: area 2 (run position): move_runner_to_archives_outermost sets only the attacked server and position. It does not end an encounter in progress or move the run to the approach-ice step (or the movement phase with no ice), and has no Success or Run Ends phase guard. move_runner_to_outermost_attacked has the same gap. cr-checker: CR 6.2.8b, 6.1.3d, 6.2.8c.

abilities: you may pay 1[credit] to place 1 advancement counter on an unrezzed card you can advance
pt-untaian-lifes-building-blocks.note: area 11 (costs): the pay-1 option is not gated on having 1 credit. Also area 12: place_advancements with pick choose offers a Decline after the credit is paid. cr-checker: CR 1.16.11a, 1.16.1.

public-access-plaza.note: Gain 1 at turn begin; threat 2: 1 tag when the Runner trashes it while rezzed.

public-trail.note: Play only after a successful run last turn; 1 tag unless the Runner pays 8.

read-write-share.note: Limit 4 hosted; on install and turn begin, may host 1 grip card facedown (not installed) to draw 1; trash: shuffle hosted cards into the stack.

realloc.note: Additional click; choose 2 rezzed ice, gain each one's printed rez cost and derez it.

abilities: Install and rez 1 piece of ice from Archives, paying a total of 10[credit] less.
reanimation-protocol.note: Area 5 (Corp install) with area 7 (rez): install_and_rez_archives_ice installs and rezzes inline: printed rez cost only (no rez modifiers or restrictions), no additional rez costs, the play fails instead of installing when only the rez is unaffordable, no optional ice trash, no new-remote hooks, rezzes before the install triggers. The total discount split and the non-liability bad publicity match. cr-checker: CR 8.1.2e, 1.16.4b, 1.16.4c, 8.5.15, 8.5.16c, 8.5.16e.

red-team.note: Loads 12 credits, trashed when empty; click: run a central not run this turn, if successful take 3.

regolith-mining-license.note: Loads 15 credits on rez, trashed when empty; click: take 3.

abilities: The first time each turn you trash a card you are accessing, gain 1 credit and draw 1 card
rene-loup-arcemont-party-animal.note: Area 8 (access): the gain and draw is inline in only the pay-trash-cost access path. Carnivore, virus and other access-trash paths never trigger it or mark the turn's first trash; it resolves at once rather than pending, and does not check blanking. Fix at the shared access-trash point. cr-checker: CR 9.3.2b, 1.19.1, 9.6.2.

abilities: Install 1 agenda, asset, or piece of ice from Archives.
retirement-plan.note: Area 5 (Corp install): install_archives_card_paying writes the root and ice lists directly: no root limit (two assets or agendas can share a root), no optional trash, bare install cost without modifiers, no new-remote hooks; the options offer no new remote for ice and fail instead of resolving with no install. The extra click and allowed types match. Crick uses the same path. cr-checker: CR 8.5.6a, 4.6.6e, 8.5.6b, 1.16.4a, 8.5.2a.

retribution.note: Play only if the Runner is tagged; trash 1 installed program or hardware.

reverb.note: Rez cost -1 per other unrezzed ice; end the run twice.

rising-tide.note: +1 strength per fracter in the heap; interface 1 credit breaks 1 barrier subroutine; 1 credit +1 strength.

rotary.note: Unique console, +1 MU; on HQ or R&D breach, may take 1 tag to access 1 more; Corp may click, 2 credits to trash it while the Runner is tagged.

abilities: gain 1[credit] and the Corp trashes 1 card from HQ
ryo-phoenix-ono-out-of-the-ashes.note: ryo_phoenix_on_successful_run trashes a random HQ card. The text makes the Corp choose; nothing says random.

sacrifice-zone-expansion.note: Install only faceup; first advance each turn gains 3 (advance action only); once per turn on a successful run on another server, may remove 1 advancement counter for 1 meat damage.

sang-kancil.note: Interface 1 credit breaks 1 code gate subroutine; 3 credits +2 strength, 2 less while a run event is active (the discount reads only paid abilities, so it hits the pump and not the break).

abilities: Choose 1 installed Runner card. The Runner shuffles it into the stack.
scapegoat.note: shuffle_installed_runner_into_stack offers every Runner card with a hostId, including cards hosted but not installed (Read-Write Share's facedown cards). The Runner's mode choice, Corp's card choice and Runner's shuffle match.

abilities: [subroutine] You may install 1 card from HQ
scatter-field.note: area 5 (Corp install): install_hq_card_paying_costs always creates a new remote and installs there, ice included, so no existing server or central root can be chosen; it also skips the like-card trash and server restrictions. cr-checker: CR 8.5.2a, 8.5.2c.

abilities: Install 1 program from your heap
scrounge.note: area 6 (Runner install): the effect install helpers (may_install_from_grip, install_from_grip_discount, canInstallHeapCard) drop every program that would exceed free MU instead of letting the Runner trash programs to make room, and drop trojans and install-on-ice cards outright. cr-checker: CR 8.5.6c, 3.9.3b, 1.13.6c.

abilities: Place 2 advancement counters on 1 installed card that you did not install this turn
seamless-launch.note: preferNotInstalledThisTurn falls back to cards installed this turn when no other target exists; targets are limited to advanceable Corp cards, but placing counters is not advancing; and no pick is set, so the first candidate is used without a choice.

sell-out.note: Additional cost: trash 1 installed resource; gain 4 and draw 2.

semak-samun.note: Its printed subroutine can be broken only by a fracter; end the run unless the Runner takes 3 net damage.

send-a-message.note: On score or steal, may rez 1 installed ice ignoring all costs (flag builds rez_ice_ignoring_costs).

abilities: you may remove 1 hosted agenda counter to place 2 advancement counters on 1 installed card
sericulture-expansion.note: place_advancements limits candidates to agendas and advanceable cards; the text allows any installed card. It also offers a Decline after the agenda counter is removed (that Decline is the shared place_advancements behaviour, area 12).

shackleton-grid.note: Once per turn, when the Runner spends credits from outside the pool during a run on this server, may do 4 meat damage; region limit.

shred.note: Run any server; the first time the run would end, the Corp may reveal and trash X random HQ cards (X = root cards) to let it end, and cannot with fewer than X in HQ.

side-hustle.note: 1 credit on install and on each run begin; at 6 or more takes all, is trashed and draws 1.

abilities: The first time each turn you pass the outermost piece of ice protecting a server after fully breaking it, you may swap it with another installed piece of ice.
sipa.note: The conditional is noted with Sipa as its source, and may_swap_ice_with_other_installed swaps the source, finds Sipa is not installed ice and does nothing, so no swap ever happens. It is also modelled as a static and skipped when any choice is open.

sleipnir.note: May draw 1; may shuffle 1 card from HQ or Archives into R&D; end the run.

abilities: When your turn begins, take 1 credit
smartware-distributor.note: Modelled as a second click ability (click: take 1 hosted credit). The printed text is a turn-begins conditional ability with no cost.

spin-doctor.note: Unique; draw 2 on rez; remove from the game: shuffle up to 2 from Archives into R&D. The IR's windows list only corp_action_paw, but the engine opens a no-click paid ability in every regular paid-ability window (paidAbilityOpenIn in src/state/costs.ts; checked: Runner action, run initiation, approach and encounter windows all open), as CR 9.2.7b requires.

sprint.note: Draw 3, then shuffle 2 cards from HQ into R&D.

stick-and-poke.note: Unique; first ice encountered each turn gains a first subroutine: 1 net damage, Runner draws 1.

abilities: Whenever you make a successful run on this server, gain 2[credit].
stowaway.note: Stowaway is in runner.installed, and the successful-run loop over every installed Runner card queues it on any server; the host-server loop in graph.ts is redundant. It gains 2 on successful runs anywhere. Install only on ice matches.

superconducting-hub.note: On score, may draw 2; +2 maximum hand size.

abilities: When the Runner encounters this ice, if it has 3 or more hosted advancement counters, you may place 1 advancement counter on an installed card you can advance
[subroutine] You may place 1 advancement counter on an installed card you can advance
syailendra.note: Both use place_advancements with no pick, so the counter goes on the first candidate with no Corp choice. Minor: the 3-counter check is part of the trigger condition but is read at resolution.

abilities: The first time each turn a tag is removed, you may reveal and install 1 card from HQ, ignoring all costs
synapse-global-faster-than-thought.note: area 5 (Corp install): install_hq_card_ignore_costs / install_archives_card_ignore_costs place the card inline; upgrades cannot go in a central root, ice gets no new remote, an agenda or asset already in the root is not trashed, and the card is installed faceup (a reveal is not a faceup install). The once-per-turn trigger and the click ability match. cr-checker: CR 8.5.2, 1.21.3, 8.5.6a.

synchrocyclotron.note: Unique; first double operation each turn costs a click less.

tailgate.note: Play cost -1 per ice protecting HQ; run HQ, access 2 more on breach.

take-a-dive.note: Run HQ or R&D; if successful and a subroutine resolved this run, 1 bad publicity; removed from the game.

tao-salonga-telepresence-magician.note: Whenever an agenda is scored or stolen, may swap 2 installed ice (flag builds swap_two_ice).

telework-contract.note: Loads 9 credits, trashed when empty; once per turn, click: take 3.

the-red-room.note: Unique, central only; first agenda scored or stolen each turn places 1 power counter; power counter: end the run during a run on another server.

abilities: +1 MU (not printed)
The first time each turn you break a subroutine on a piece of ice with 0 or less strength, gain 1[credit].
the-tungsten-tailor.note: Declares muBonus 1, which the card does not print. The credit gain is inline in the break kind: it is added at once instead of becoming a pending conditional, and does not check whether the card's abilities are suppressed. Unique and -1 strength to each ice match.

the-zwicky-group-invisible-hands.note: First credit gain each turn from an agenda or operation ability: may draw 1 (only gains above 0 count).

abilities: [click], 1[credit], reveal and trash this ice from HQ: Search R&D for up to 1 barrier and up to 1 sentry and reveal them. Add those cards to HQ.
tocsin.note: search_rd_up_to_one_each_subtype_to_hq takes the first barrier and first sentry in R&D order: no Corp choice and no option to find fewer; it also adds them to HQ before shuffling. The reveal in the cost is missing for every expendable card (Found, not fixed). The three subroutines match.

tomorrows-headline.note: On score or steal, give the Runner 1 tag.

abilities: Install up to 2 cards from HQ (one at a time)
top-down-solutions.note: area 5 (Corp install): install_hq_card_paying_costs always creates a new remote and installs there, ice included, so no existing server or central root can be chosen; it also skips the like-card trash and server restrictions. cr-checker: CR 8.5.2a, 8.5.2c.

abilities: Once per turn → [click]: Install 1 card from your grip, paying 2[credit] less
topan-ormas-leader.note: area 6 (Runner install): the effect install helpers (may_install_from_grip, install_from_grip_discount, canInstallHeapCard) drop every program that would exceed free MU instead of letting the Runner trash programs to make room, and drop trojans and install-on-ice cards outright. It also checks the credit pool, not credits available for installs. cr-checker: CR 8.5.6c, 3.9.3b, 1.13.6c.

abilities: Place 2 advancement counters on 1 installed card you can advance. If you do, choose a card type and reveal the grip
touch-ups.note: Already in the plan's findings, area 13: the reveal does not depend on 'If you do', and choose_type_shuffle_grip offers a Decline. Confirmed: place_advancements with pick choose also offers a Decline (area 12).

touchstone.note: Unique; first event each turn places 1 hosted credit; hosted credits spendable during runs.

tranquilizer.note: Installs only on ice; 1 virus counter on install and turn begin, then derez host at 3 or more.

transfer-of-wealth.note: Run HQ; if successful take 1 tag, the Corp loses 3 and the Runner gains 2 per credit actually lost.

tread-lightly.note: Run any server; ice rez cost +3 during that run.

underdome-irregulars.note: Runner action phase ends: if ice was rezzed this turn draw 2 or remove 1 tag, else trash this.

unity.note: Decoder 1 strength: 1 credit breaks 1 code gate subroutine; 1 credit +X strength, X = installed icebreakers.

unleash.note: Additional cost: remove 1 tag; rez 1 installed ice ignoring costs, may resolve 1 of its subroutines.

abilities: When the Runner accesses this asset while it is installed, do 2 net damage plus 1 per advancement counter
urtica-cipher.note: The card has no onAccessRequiresInstalled flag, so the damage also fires when it is accessed in HQ, R&D or Archives.

verbal-plasticity.note: Unique; first basic draw action each turn draws 2 instead.

vertigo.note: On pass with no clicks left, Runner cannot steal or trash this run; Runner loses a click.

vicsek.note: X net damage and X tags, X = Runner's tags; 1 tag and trash this ice.

virtual-intelligence-p-i-you-can-call-me.note: Once per turn, click, 1 credit: draw 1 and remove 1 tag.

vrcation.note: Draw 4; lose a click if any remain.

abilities: Whenever you advance a card, gain 2 credits if it had no advancement counters
weyland-consortium-built-to-last.note: The engine-side hook (src/legality/checkpoints.ts) reads any advancement-counter increase from 0, so placing or moving counters (Seamless Launch) also gains 2 credits. Only advancing should.

whitespace.note: Runner loses 3 credits; end the run if the Runner has 6 credits or less.

wildcat-strike.note: Corp chooses: Runner gains 6 credits or draws 4.

witch-hunt.note: Bad publicity on score or steal; Corp action phase end after scoring it this turn: remove all tags, give 3.

word-on-the-street.note: Unique; additional cost to score an agenda installed this turn: Corp adds it to their score area as a -1 agenda they cannot forfeit; when the Corp scores an agenda not installed this turn, trash it, gain 4, draw 1.

zahya-sadeghi-versatile-smuggler.note: Once per turn, when an HQ or R&D run ends, may gain 1 credit per card accessed.
